description: This file configures and manages the database connection using TypeORM for a MySQL database, including environment-based configuration, SSL options, connection initialization, and health checks.

methods.name: parseIntEnv
methods.description: Safely parses an environment variable into an integer, with fallback.

methods.name: describeTarget
methods.description: Creates a string description of the database target (host:port/database).

methods.name: buildMySqlSslOptionsFromEnv
methods.description: Builds SSL options for MySQL connection based on environment variables, including CA certificate handling.

methods.name: buildMySqlDataSourceOptionsFromEnv
methods.description: Constructs the DataSource configuration object for MySQL from environment variables.

methods.name: getDataSource
methods.description: Returns the singleton DataSource instance if initialized.

methods.name: getDbMeta
methods.description: Returns non-secret metadata about the configured database.

methods.name: createDataSourceFromEnv
methods.description: Creates a new DataSource object based on environment variables without initializing it.

methods.name: initializeDataSource
methods.description: Initializes the DataSource singleton, establishing a database connection.

methods.name: checkDatabaseConnectivity
methods.description: Performs a simple query to check if the database connection is active.

methods.name: getConfiguredDbName
methods.description: Returns the configured database name from environment variables.
